primitives.name: Video Explainer Block
primitives.verbatim_quote: --version: 0.12.0 name: higgsfield-video-explainer description: | Build a complete non-photoreal narrated explainer or story video from ordered 10-second blocks: one narrator, one universal style key, one Seed Audio take and one Gemini Omni clip per block, then server-side assembly with explainer_video.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'N': 'number of 10-second blocks', 'T': 'total duration in minutes', 'S': 'style key identifier'}
primitives.assumptions: Each block is independent; style key is fixed across blocks; narration and visuals are synchronized.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T > 10 minutes or N > 60, system requires explicit user input for duration adjustment.

layer2.mapping: Each block corresponds to a unitary step in a Markovian narrative process where S is the invariant state parameter.
layer2.telemetry: Number of successfully assembled blocks vs. expected N.

primitives.name: Narrative Segmentation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Lock one visual style key, write one narration line and one matching visual prompt per 10-second block, generate every voice take first, generate every clip second, then immediately assemble the ordered pairs with `explainer_video`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L_n': 'narration line for block n', 'V_n': 'visual prompt for block n', 'A_n': 'audio job UUID for block n'}
primitives.assumptions: Narration and visual prompts must be aligned temporally; each block has unique L_n and V_n.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if L_n or V_n is missing or mismatched across blocks.

layer2.mapping: Kernel of temporal alignment between L_n and V_n defines the core narrative kernel of the explainer.
layer2.telemetry: Alignment score between narration and visual prompt per block.

primitives.name: Style Key Resolution
primitives.verbatim_quote: Supports live CMS presets, custom style references, mascot/faceless modes, two aspects, and optional burned subtitles.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'K': 'style key object', 'P': 'preset UUID', 'M': 'media ID from CMS'}
primitives.assumptions: Style key K is immutable once resolved; P uniquely identifies a CMS preset.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Resolution fails if P does not exist in live catalog.

layer2.mapping: Style key K is isomorphic to a fixed-point in a space of visual descriptors defined by CMS.
layer2.telemetry: Validation of M against CMS catalog.
